notes.title: ATTENTION: INDEX CONTROLLERS
notes.notes:
[b]Attention Totally Baseball players using Index controllers.[/b]
We were recently informed of a bug where the AI is ignoring the ball in single player.  This is a byproduct of the them thinking the ball is in the pitcher's hand when it is not.  This is due to an update we did to smooth out gameplay but for some reason only affected the INDEX Controllers (all other controllers are fine)  We thank the players who reached out and apologize for the inconvenience and ask for your patience while we work on getting this issue resolved so you can resume your normal Totally Baseball enjoyment.  The fix should be in place sometime soon, we will keep you updated-

notes.title: NO MORE LIMITS
notes.notes:
In updates to the game around a month ago we added code so that players couldn't hit too many consecutive homeruns, these fixes were made not just for the singleplayer game but specifically to have some things in place so that multiplayer mode (coming soon) would function better.  Alternatively, we came up with a new pitching system so the speeds and directions from pitches vary much more and add a new layer of challenge to batting.   With this new method in place, we no longer see a need for any kind of limits.  We really hope you enjoy the game and if the limits lead to you leaving an angry comment, we hope the update makes you happy and you can enjoy the game again.
